heading: Common gotchas
text:
## Common gotchas [NTST.11]

| Symptom                                    | Likely cause                                                        |
|--------------------------------------------|---------------------------------------------------------------------|
| Test passes locally, flakes in CI          | Live clock somewhere; switch to mock.                               |
| Stream cb sees zero events                 | Registered after `assert` / `load`; register first.                 |
| `ds_engine_pump` returns `DS_ERR_STORAGE_UNAVAILABLE` | A rule fired an action verb you didn't wire a callback for.       |
| Asserting a fact yields no rule fire       | Pattern doesn't match (slot value off?), or rule already refracted. |
| TTL retract doesn't fire                   | Clock not advanced past deadline before pump.                       |
| Two engines disagree on event order        | LDET contract holds across pumps but each engine has own seq counter. |
